official_secure_channel_note: Use only the named official website, secure HTTPS form, verified office phone, or in-person office path for sensitive case details and documents. If the current public instructions do not show a secure submission path, call the responsible election office first before sending records.
minimum_necessary_disclosure_note: Send only the personal information the current official process requires. Do not post or send full Social Security numbers, driver's license numbers, dates of birth, confidential residence details, court papers, custody records, or other sensitive identifiers through public, unverified, or generalized channels.
operability_now_note: Before relying on this path under same-day or near-cutoff pressure, verify that the responsible office, portal, site, or delivery route is still open and operating right now using the latest official hours/closure notice, current update page, or verified office phone.
deadline_imminence_note: Do not assume an older FAQ, PDF, screenshot, or cached directory still controls today's path. If the cutoff is near or may already have passed, confirm the current live deadline with the responsible office and pivot immediately to the stated fallback or confirmation path if the original route is no longer operable.
current_official_controls_note: The current directly governing state or local election-office source controls for this case. National routing pages, generalized official explainers, and archive summaries are routing aids only and are not substitutes for the current official instruction that directly governs the voter's jurisdiction and election scope.
superseding_notice_note: Older pages, PDFs, screenshots, packet inserts, or archived summaries may remain visible. Follow the most current official notice, form, correction, update, or replacement instruction and use the dated or last-updated cue when available.
unresolved_conflict_stop_note: If current official materials still materially conflict, disagree, or leave a controlling gap, do not synthesize an answer from fragments. Treat that unresolved conflict as a stop condition and use the responsible official office or help path for case-specific confirmation; move to the rights/safety escalation lane when the conflict is paired with likely wrongful denial, intimidation, discrimination, or unsafe exposure.
pre_naturalization_warning_summary: Publish clearly that a person must not register before becoming a U.S. citizen.
post_naturalization_registration_summary: Publish what changes immediately after naturalization and whether the ordinary registration path is now available.
deadline_exception_or_same_day_summary: If new citizens have a late-deadline exception or same-day-registration path, say so plainly and link it.
proof_or_in_person_requirement_summary: If a certificate of naturalization, ceremony-date proof, declaration, or in-person visit is required, say so plainly.
online_or_dmv_availability_summary: If online/DMV registration is unavailable immediately after naturalization, publish the paper or in-person fallback path.
official_help_path_summary: Name the county or state election office that resolves time-sensitive new-citizen registration questions.

scenario_models.plain_language: The person is already naturalized before the ordinary registration deadline and can use the normal registration path.
scenario_models.citizenship_timing_rule: State clearly that registration is allowed only after citizenship is complete.
scenario_models.registration_path_rule: Point to the ordinary current registration path that now applies.
scenario_models.proof_rule: If the jurisdiction requires any citizenship proof at registration, say so; otherwise say the ordinary application path controls.
scenario_models.online_or_paper_rule: State whether the online/DMV path is available now or whether a paper fallback is safer for new citizens.
scenario_models.help_path_rule: Name the office that can confirm the current operational answer.

scenario_models.plain_language: The person became a citizen after the ordinary registration deadline and needs the special post-naturalization path.
scenario_models.citizenship_timing_rule: State that the person may now register only through the current late-naturalization exception, same-day-registration path, or other official fallback described by the jurisdiction.
scenario_models.registration_path_rule: Point to the office, early-voting location, or election-day path that controls.
scenario_models.proof_rule: State what certificate, ceremony-date proof, or declaration is required.
scenario_models.online_or_paper_rule: State whether online registration is unavailable and whether in-person registration is required.
scenario_models.help_path_rule: Name the office or hotline that resolves close-to-deadline questions safely.
